description: This is a FastAPI backend implementation for an investment teaser generation service. It includes endpoints for health check, scraping company info, file uploads, company confirmation, teaser generation, and export. The code defines route handlers, request/response models, middleware, and database interactions.

classes.name: ScrapeRequest
classes.description: Request model containing the URL to scrape for company info.

classes.name: ScrapeResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the scraped company info and status.

classes.name: UploadResponse
classes.description: Response model containing details of uploaded files.

classes.name: UploadedFileInfo
classes.description: Model representing information about an uploaded file.

classes.name: ConfirmCompanyRequest
classes.description: Request model for confirming or editing company data.

classes.name: ConfirmCompanyResponse
classes.description: Response model containing session ID after confirmation.

classes.name: TeaserGenerationRequest
classes.description: Request model for triggering teaser generation with session ID.

classes.name: TeaserGenerationResponse
classes.description: Response model containing teaser content and status.

classes.name: ExportResponse
classes.description: Model with export details such as filename and download URL.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint, returns service status.

methods.name: on_startup()
methods.description: Initializes database tables on application startup.

methods.name: scrape_company(req: ScrapeRequest)
methods.description: Endpoint to scrape company info from a website URL.

methods.name: upload_files( files: List[UploadFile] = File(..., description="One or more files to upload (PDF, DOCX, TXT, XLSX)."), company_id: Optional[UUID] = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles file uploads, storing metadata and previews.

methods.name: confirm_company( req: ConfirmCompanyRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Accepts confirmed or edited company data and starts teaser workflow.

methods.name: generate_teaser( req: TeaserGenerationRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Triggers AI-based teaser generation based on company data.

methods.name: export_teaser( teaser_id: UUID, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Exports the generated teaser as a downloadable PDF.
